name: v1.0.0-11 - Settings
body: This release finally implements the Electron settings.

name: v1.0.0-10 - New domain
body: This release fixes the app URL after switching our domain to https://hermesmessenger.chat.

name: v1.0.0-9 - Update Electron
body: This release has no changes, apart from updating Electron from `v4.0.1` to `v4.0.5`.

name: v1.0.0-8 - New app icon
body: This release contains the new app icon designed by @Tloru

name: v1.0.0-7 - Fix auto updates
body: This release fixes the error caused by the auto updates.

name: v1.0.0-6 - Electron 4
body:
This release contains an updated version of Electron, as well as other new features: 

 - Automatic update checks 
 - Keyboard shortcuts on macOS
 - Opening links in your default browser

name: v1.0.0-5 - More bug fixes
body: This release has some bug fixes.

name: v1.0.0-4 - Many fixes
body:
This release has many fixes and some new features: 

- Added introducton to app on first launch **(NOT COMPLETELY DESIGNED)**
- Keep user logged in after app restarts **(USES HERMES FEATURE IN TESTING)**
- Fix errors with icons on Mac OS & Windows
- Background service improved
- Use Travis CI to create binaries automatically
- Many other improvements

name: v1.0.0-3 - Installers
body:
This release has two major improvements over the previous one: 
- Installers are now available
- Desktop notifications now work on all operating systems

*However, the second bug from v1.0.0-1 still applies:*
 - *You have to log in every time you open the app*

---

*The code has also been beautified and improved, but that's not important to the end user.*

name: v1.0.0-2 - Icon Fixes
body:
In this release there are some fixes related to the mac app icon.
Also, now the app closes when the window is closed.
The bugs mentioned on the 1.0.0-1 release are still present.

name: v1.0.0-1 - Initial Release
body:
This is the initial (test) release of the desktop app for Hermes. 

There are some bugs that have to be fixed, such as:
- No notifications 
- Having to log in every time you open the app

However, other than that, the app is the same as the normal website.
